content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-every-detail-you-7|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-stock-photos-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-17|Selling Stock]] Notion templates for crypto represents a transformative shift in the digital commerce landscape. Rather than relying on conventional platforms that impose high fees and restrictions, creators can utilize infrastructure that empowers them to transact directly with customers. This approach not only enhances profitability by significantly reducing transaction fees but also provides creators with complete ownership over their sales process. The difference in fees is substantial; for instance, while Gumroad takes 10% from each sale, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This means that for 100 monthly sales of a $97 product, creators retain $921 more in their pockets, illustrating why this model matters.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling Notion templates for crypto is straightforward yet robust. At its core, it involves a combination of free tools and services that work seamlessly together. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, creators can host their templates without incurring costs. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, enabling automated delivery of purchased products. Payment processing is managed by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions instantly on the blockchain. This system not only ensures quick delivery but also maintains low operational costs, allowing creators to focus on what they do best: creating.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. This includes creators from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and many others who sell ebooks, courses, and various digital products. These individuals often face financial isolation due to the unavailability of payment service providers. By utilizing COREMERCH's architecture, they can bypass these limitations, allowing them to monetize their work without relying on conventional payment systems that have historically shut them out.
Keep 91% of your earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully sell Notion templates for crypto, several key components must be integrated. First, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display your products. Second, implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage the logic for product delivery. Third, utilize NOWPayments for payment processing, ensuring you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies without KYC requirements. Finally, your storage solution can be managed through Google Drive or a similar service. Together, these elements create a cohesive and efficient system for digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your digital commerce stack is a straightforward process. Start by setting up your hosting environment using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create your product listings and upload your Notion templates. After that, configure your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, and ensure your storage solution is ready for file delivery. Finally, test the entire process thoroughly to confirm everything functions seamlessly. For those looking for an all-in-one solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides everything you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using alternative payment processors that allow for cryptocurrency transactions. Services like NOWPayments enable creators to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies without facing the restrictions of conventional platforms. This setup allows you to keep more of your earnings and maintain control over your sales.
Take control of your sales process without platform dependency.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Using cryptocurrency for sales offers lower transaction fees, faster payment processing, and no reliance on traditional banks or payment processors. This empowers creators and enhances profit margins.

NOWPayments integrates seamlessly into your sales process, allowing you to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies. It automatically verifies transactions on-chain, facilitating instant payment confirmation and delivery.
